chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to one of his wives: “Hand me the khumrah.”
So she said to him, “I am menstruating.” He said to her, “Is your menstruation in your hand?”

key_terms.الْخُمْرَةَ: a small mat or cloth used for sajdah
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نَاوِلِينِي: hand to me; pass to me

ai.seo_question: Does menstruation prevent a woman from touching or handing over a prayer mat?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم asked one of his wives to hand him a khumrah, and when she mentioned that she was menstruating, he replied that her menstruation was not in her hand. The report indicates that menstruation does not render the entire body or ordinary touch impure, and it is relevant to discussions of ritual purity and prayer-related items.
